title: Kirdaar ko harkat dein
body:
Kirdaar ki ek aaraam ki animation ho sakti hai jo us waqt dohraati rehti hai jab woh hil nahin rahe hote.

Misaal ke taur par, aayein is billi ko ghoomne aur khisakne se thoda sa nachaain:

\
Phrase(
    '🐈' 
    rukna: Sequence({
        0%: Pose(ghumaao: 0°)
        15%: Pose(ghumaao: 15°)
        30%: Pose(ghumaao: 0°)
        45%: Pose(hatao: Place(-0.25m))
        60%: Pose(hatao: Place(0.25m))
        75%: Pose(hatao: Place(-0.25m))
        90%: Pose(hatao: Place(0m))
    } 2s)
)
\

 Is misaal mein ek istemaal hota hai @Sequence alag alag ka @Pose.

title: Kisi harf ko hilne ke qabil banayein
body:
Kabhi kabhi yeh madadgaar hota hai ke aap @Phrase ko keyboard, mouse, ya ungli se hilne ke qabil banayein.

Yeh karne ke liye, hum mila sakte hain @Phrase ke saath @Placement deta hai:

\
Stage(
	[Jumla('mujhe hilaain' jagah: Thikana())]
	jagah: Jagah(0m 0m -10m)
)
\

 Keyboard ke teer istemaal karna ya is par click karna @Stage ko tabdeel karega @Placement, jis se @Phrase us simt mein hilega.

Kya aap jaante hain ke @Placement ko is ke saath istemaal kiya ja sakta hai / kisi bhi cheez / ke saath jo leti hai @Place? 
Misaal ke taur par @Stage mein ek @Place hota hai jo tay karta hai ke is ka camera kahan dekh raha hai.
Aayein aazmayein ke @Placement ke liye @Stage ki jagah tay karein, aur dekhein kya hota hai.

\
Stage(
  [
	Jumla('🐈' jagah: Jagah(-2m 2m))
	Jumla('🐈' jagah: Jagah(2m -2m))
	Jumla('🐈' jagah: Jagah(-1m 3m))
  ]
  jagah: Thikana(Jagah(0m 0m -10m))
)
\

 Is se camera hilta hai! (Dhyaan dein: hum aaghaz karte hain @Placement ke saath ek \z\ qeemat se \10m\ taake camera har cheez se peeche rahe.)

title: Apna banaya hua character dikhayein
body:
Emoji, huroof aur nishaan bahut achhe hain! Lekin kabhi kabhi aap apne khud ke character banana chahte hain.
Aap apna character kaise banayein aur dikhayein?

Sab se pehle, is page par character banayein: < Kirdaar @://characters> page. 
Aap pixel, chaukor, gole aur raaste istemaal kar sakte hain. 
Usay ek naam dein, uske baare mein likhein, phir aap apna user naam aur character ka naam is tarah istemaal kar sakte hain:

\
Phrase(`Mera shandaar @username/charactername dekhein!`)
\

 Yeh user naam aur character ka naam maujood nahin hai, is liye yeh khaali chaukor ki tarah dikhega.
Apna asli user naam aur character ka naam hi istemaal karein

Dekhein, matn mein quote ke nishaan ki jagah backtick istemaal hua hai? Yeh zaroori hai. 
Yeh batata hai ke aap saja hua matn istemaal kar rahe hain, aur apne banaye hue character ko dikhane ke liye yeh zaroori hai.

Matn ko saja kar likhne ke baare mein aap mazeed seekh sakte hain: @Phrase na ho.

title: Apne matn ko saja hua banayein
body:
Kabhi kabhi hum chahte hain ke hamara matn alag nazar aaye. Hum yeh is tarah kar sakte hain: / tirchha karke /, * mota karke *, aur bhi bohat kuchh!

Misaal ke taur par, matn ko tirchha karne ke liye usay do slash // mein band karein, jaise //Hello//. Misaal:


\
Group(Tah() [
        Jumla(`Kya aap apne matn mein /tirchhe huroof/ istemaal karna chahte hain?`)
        Jumla(`Yeh kisi baat par zor dene ke liye ya apne alfaaz ko /khaas andaaz/ dene ke liye achha hai.`)
        Jumla(`Bas lafz ya jumle se pehle aur baad mein slash (//) lagayein, /is tarah/.`)
    ]
)
\


@Phrase matn ko mota bhi kar sakta hai. Iske liye apne matn ko do sitaron ** mein band karein, jaise **Hello**. Misaal:

\
Group(Tah() [
        Jumla(`Kya aap apne matn ko *mote huroof* se numaya karna chahte hain?`)
        Jumla(`Jab aapko *zor se pukarna* ho, tab yeh bilkul munasib hai.`)
        Jumla(`Bas apne alfaaz ke aas paas ek ek asterisk (**) lagayein, jaise *wah!*, aur farq dekhein.`)
      ]
)
\

@Phrase matn ko bohat hi mota bhi bana sakta hai. Iske liye apne matn ko do caret ^^ mein band karein, jaise ^^Hello^^. Misaal:

\
Group(Tah() [
        Jumla(`Jab aapko andaaz sab se zyada tez karna ho, tab ^bohat mote^ huroof sab se behtareen hain.`)
        Jumla(`Yeh mote huroof jaisa hai lekin zyada ^zordaar^, aur aam taur par ek ek caret (^^) lagane se banta hai.`)
        Jumla(`Isay ^sarkhiyon^ ya ^bari baaton^ ko numaya karne ke liye istemaal karein.`)
    ]
)
\

 Aakhir mein, @Phrase matn ke neeche lakeer bhi laga sakta hai. Iske liye apne matn ko do underscore __ mein band karein, jaise __Hello__. Misaal:

\
Group(Tah() [
        Jumla(`Jab aap matn ko saada rakhna chahte hain lekin phir bhi numaya karna chahte hain, tab _lakeer_ bohat achhi hai.`)
        Jumla(`Apne matn se pehle aur baad mein ek ek underscore (__) lagayein, _is tarah_, aur saaf zor mil jata hai.`)
        Jumla(`Yeh apni baat kehne ke liye _bilkul theek_ hai, bina _zarurat se zyada_ kiye.`)
    ]
)
\

title: Manazir ki ek animated silsila banayein
body:
Kabhi kabhi hum kahaniyan sunana, geet ke bol dikhana, ya shayari ko animate karna chahte hain.
Iske liye hum istemaal kar sakte hain @Scene aur @Phrase ko saath mein, taake ek tarteeb dikha sakein.

Misaal ke taur par, sochein ke hum chhoti si bachchon ki nazm "Jack be Nimble" ko animate karna chahte hain.
Hum ek @Scene bana sakte hain jis mein har misra ek @Phrase ho, aur har misre ki @Phrase/duration tay karke, @Scene aage barhega jab har lafzon ka tukda mukammal ho jaye.

\
Manzar([
  Jumla('Jack phurteela bano' muddat: 1s)
  Jumla('Jack tez bano' muddat: 1s)
  Jumla('Jack mombatti ke stand ke upar se koodo' muddat: 1s)
])
\

@Scene ek @Sequence ke mukammal hone ka bhi intezaar karega. Chalein, mombatti wale misre ko uchhalne dein!

\
Manzar([
		Jumla('Jack phurteela bano' muddat: 1s)
		Jumla('Jack tez bano' muddat: 1s)
		Jumla('Jack mombatti ke stand ke upar se koodo' aana: Silsila.uchhalna(muddat: 1s))
	])
\

@Scene ek @Group bhi le sakta hai matn ki, aur woh uske tamaam mawaad ki animation khatam hone ka intezaar karega.

\
Manzar([
		Group(Tah() [
      Jumla('Jack phurteela bano')
		  Jumla('Jack tez bano')
    ] muddat: 2s)
		Jumla('Jack mombatti ke stand ke upar se koodo' aana: Silsila.uchhalna(muddat: 1s))
	])
\

 Kabhi kabhi nazm ko chalte rehna chahiye. @Scene/loop  @Scene ko wapas ghuma kar apne pehle @Phrase par le aata hai jab aakhri khatam ho jaye, is liye woh khud ko baar baar dohrata hai.

\
Manzar([
		Jumla('Jack phurteela bano' muddat: 1s)
		Jumla('Jack tez bano' muddat: 1s)
		Jumla('Jack mombatti ke stand ke upar se koodo' muddat: 1s)
	] chakkar: ⊤)
\

 Yaad rakhein: ek @Scene tabhi wapas ghoomta hai jab list mein koi cheez waqai intezaar karti ho.
Woh list jis mein har @Phrase ki @Phrase/duration  \0s\ ho, computer ki poori raftaar se ghoomti rahegi, is liye woh aakhir mein ruk jati hai.

title: Scenes ki ek interactive silsila banayein
body:
Kabhi kabhi hum aisi kahaaniyan sunana chahte hain jo agle hisse par jaane se pehle dekhne wale ke kuch karne ka intezaar karti hain.

Iske liye hum istemaal kar sakte hain @Scene, lekin rakhein @Boolean qeematein us mawaad ke beech jo hum dikhana chahte hain. Misaal ke taur par, yahan ek click har agle hisse par le jaaye ga, @Button deta hai:

\
Manzar([
		Jumla('mujh par click karein')
		Button()
		Jumla('mujh par dobara click karein' muddat: 1s)
		Button()
		Jumla('nahin, waqai, mujh par poori taaqat se click karein!!' muddat: 1s)
		Button()
		Jumla('kya aap ne abhi tak mujh par click kiya?' muddat: 1s)
	])
\

 Yeh @Scene pehla dikhata hai @Phrase, phir intezaar karta hai @Button ke sach hone ka, aur jab woh sach ho jaaye, to agle par chala jaata hai @Phrase na ho.

Aage badhne ke liye aap kuch bhi istemaal kar sakte hain, bas woh sach ya jhoot hona chahiye. 
Misaal ke taur par, hum apni aawaaz istemaal kar sakte hain! 
Agar hum kaafi zor se chillayein, to scene aage badh jaaye gi:

\
Manzar([
		Jumla('kya wahan koi hai?')
		AwaazKiUnchaai() > .5
		Jumla('mujhe aap ki aawaaz nahin aa rahi, dobara kahein?' muddat: 1s)
		AwaazKiUnchaai() > .7
		Jumla('zara zor se kahein...' muddat: 1s)
		AwaazKiUnchaai() > .9
		Jumla('oh, salaam!' muddat: 1s)
	])
\

 Jab har @Phrase ko ek hi cheez ka intezaar karna ho, @Scene/until ise ek hi baar kehta hai, har ek ke beech likhne ke bajaye. Yeh wahi karta hai jo upar ki pehli misaal karti hai:

\
Manzar([
		Jumla('mujh par click karein')
		Jumla('mujh par dobara click karein' muddat: 1s)
		Jumla('nahin, waqai, mujh par poori taaqat se click karein!!' muddat: 1s)
		Jumla('kya aap ne abhi tak mujh par click kiya?' muddat: 1s)
	] jabTak: Button())
\

 Ek likhein @Boolean list mein jab intezaar hon / alag alag /, jaise chillane wali misaal mein, aur istemaal karein @Scene/until jab woh sab ek jaise hon.
Aap dono istemaal kar sakte hain: ek @Boolean list mein apna alag intezaar hai, us ek ke ilawa jo @Scene/until maangta hai.

Note: @Scene/until intezaar karta hai / ke baad / har @Phrase ka apna @Phrase/duration, is ki jagah nahin.

Agar aap chahte hain ke @Scene khud se kabhi na hile, aur sirf wahin jaye jahan aap bhejein, to istemaal karein @Scene/pause ke saath @Scene/step deta hai:

\
kunji2: Kunji()
Manzar([
		Jumla('ek')
		Jumla('do')
		Jumla('teen')
	] waqfa qadam: ∆ kunji2 ? ((kunji2 = 'ArrowLeft') ? -1 (kunji2 = 'ArrowRight') ? 1 ø) ø)
\

@Scene/step itni tadaad se hilta hai: @Phrase — \1\ aage, \-1\ peechhe — aur siron par aap ke liye ruk jata hai.
@Scene/go wohi khayaal hai, lekin faasle ki jagah ek maqaam ke taur par: us @Phrase ka number jo aap chahte hain, 1 se ginte hue, ya woh @Phrase/name jo aap ne usay diya.

title: Teer wali kunjiyon se content ke darmiyan chalein
body:
Kabhi kabhi aap chahte hain ke dekhne wale content ko ek ek hissa karke dekhein, jaise slide show mein, aage / aur / peechhe teer wali kunjiyon se.

Is tareeqe ka har rup inhi teen hisson se banta hai:

• Us content ki ek @List jo aap dikhana chahte hain
• Us content ki ek @Key dhaara, jo har baar kunji dabane par badalti hai
• Us content ki ek @Reaction jo yaad rakhta hai ke abhi aap content ke kis hisse par hain

Yeh iska sabse chhota rup hai. Pehle stage par click karein taake woh sunne lage, phir baayein aur daayein teer ki kunji dabayein:

\
slides3: ['pehla' 'doosra' 'teesra']

kunji2: Kunji()

index2•#: 1 … ∆ kunji2 …
	(kunji2 = 'ArrowRight') ? ((index2 < slides3.lambaai()) ? index2 + 1 index2)
		(kunji2 = 'ArrowLeft') ? ((index2 > 1) ? index2 - 1 index2)
			index2

Jumla(slides3[index2])
\

 Yeh @Reaction is ka dil hai. Yeh \1\ se shuru hota hai, aur jab bhi @Key badalti hai, yeh tay karta hai ke naya number kya hona chahiye.
Agar daayein teer ki kunji dabi, to yeh ek barhata hai; agar baayein teer ki kunji dabi, to ek ghatata hai; warna number wahi rehta hai.

Yeh izaafi \?\ jaanch number ko list ke siron se aage jaane se rokti hain.
Inke baghair aap aakhri sire se aage nikal jaate aur dikhane ke liye koi slide na hoti.
Agar aap chahte hain ke aakhri slide ke baad dobara pehli slide aa jaye, to aap woh bhi kar sakte hain.

Note: teer wali kunjiyon ke naam yeh hain \'ArrowLeft'\, \'ArrowRight'\, \'ArrowUp'\, aur \'ArrowDown'\ na ho.
Aap sirf yeh bhi likh sakte hain \'Left'\ aur \'Right'\, aur kunji ke naam aapki apni zubaan mein bhi kaam karte hain.

Dekhein ke \index\ sirf ek number hai, is liye yeh / koi bhi / qism ke content ke liye kaam karta hai, sirf matn ke liye nahin.
Is @List ko badal kar ek list rakhein @Group ya poore scene, aur baaqi pattern bilkul nahin badalta:

\
slides3: [
	Jumla('teen hisson ki kahani' size: 3m)
	Group(Tah() [Jumla('🐈') Jumla('ek billi nazar aati hai')])
	Jumla('khatam 🎉')
]

kunji2: Kunji()

index2•#: 1 … ∆ kunji2 …
	(kunji2 = 'ArrowRight') ? ((index2 < slides3.lambaai()) ? index2 + 1 index2)
		(kunji2 = 'ArrowLeft') ? ((index2 > 1) ? index2 - 1 index2)
			index2

slides3[index2]
\

 Ek @Scene bhi yeh kar sakta hai, aur kam ginti ke saath.
Isay @Scene/pause dein taake yeh khud kabhi na hile, aur @Scene/step taake yeh ek tukre ko kisi bhi taraf hila sake:

\
kunji2: Kunji()
Manzar([
		Jumla('teen hisson ki kahani' size: 3m)
		Group(Tah() [Jumla('🐈') Jumla('ek billi nazar aati hai')])
		Jumla('khatam 🎉')
	] waqfa qadam: ∆ kunji2 ? ((kunji2 = 'ArrowLeft') ? -1 (kunji2 = 'ArrowRight') ? 1 ø) ø)
\

 Yahan likhne ke liye koi \?\ jaanch nahin hai, kyunke @Scene apne siron par khud ruk jata hai, aur kisi ko yaad rakhne ki zaroorat nahin ke kaun sa tukra nazar aa raha hai.
Poochhein @Spotlight agar aap kehna chahte hain / 10 mein se 3 / stage par.

Note: poore mansooba mein yeh numaish gah mein dekhein: < slide show @https://wordplay.dev/project/example-SlideShow?play>

 Yeh @Reaction upar wala tareeqa ab bhi sahi hai jab aap jis cheez par se guzar rahe hain woh output nahin hota — alfaaz, rang ya number ki list, ya koi aur cheez jis se aap tukra banate hain.

title: Khel ka ek daur dohraein
body:
Bohat se khel wohi chand lamhon ko baar baar dohrate hain: batana ke kya karna hai, jawab ka intezaar karna, dikhana ke kaisa raha, phir dobara shuru karna.
Ek @Scene poora woh daur ban sakta hai, aur @Scene/loop use wapas shuru par le aata hai.

Yeh lamhe list ki cheezein hain, aur unke darmiyan ek @Boolean woh jagah hai jahan @Scene khiladi ka intezaar karta hai.

\
andaaza2: Guftagu()
daayein2: andaaza2 = 'cat'
Manzar([
	Jumla('Janwar ka andaaza lagayein!' muddat: 2s)
	∆ andaaza2
	Jumla(daayein2 ? 'Ji haan!' 'Nahin!' muddat: 2s)
] chakkar: ~daayein2)
\

 Yeh \∆ guess\ intezaar hai: yeh sirf usi lamhe sahi hota hai jab naya andaza aata hai, is liye @Scene wahin ruka rehta hai jab tak koi kuch type na kare.
Aur \chakkar2: ~right\ dohrana hai: @Scene baar baar wapas aata rehta hai jab tak woh sahi jawab na de dein, aur phir aakhri @Phrase par ruk jaata hai.

Note: @Scene/loop har baar parha jaata hai jab aapka program badalta hai, is liye aap chakkar ko khatam bhi kar sakte hain aur shuru bhi, jo abhi \~right\ ne kiya.

Daur kahan hai, yeh jaanne ke liye poochein @Spotlight par ruk jaata hai.
Yeh batata hai ke kaun sa @Phrase nazar aa raha hai, kitne hain, @Scene kitni baar wapas aaya hai, aur kya yeh abhi kisi ka intezaar kar raha hai.

\
andaaza2: Guftagu()
par2: Roshni()
Stage([
	Manzar([
		Jumla('Janwar ka andaaza lagayein!' muddat: 2s)
		∆ andaaza2
		Jumla('Nahin!' muddat: 2s)
	] chakkar: ⊤)
	Jumla(par2.intezaar ? 'apna andaaza likhein' `daur \par2.phera + 1\` size: 0.4m jagah: Jagah(0m -2m))
])
\

@Scene/replay daur ko jab chahein dobara shuru karne ka tareeqa hai, chahe woh kahin bhi pahunch chuka ho.
Ise koi aisi cheez dein jo sirf ek lamhe ke liye sahi ho, jaise \∆ Button()\ par ruk jaata hai.

title: Tasveeron ko ek doosre ke oopar rakhein
body:
Kabhi kabhi hum tasveeron ko ek ke oopar ek rakhna chahte hain taake mazedaar manzar ya takhleeqi shaklein banayein.

Misaal ke taur par, aap apni mansooba mein kai tahein istemaal kar sakte hain @Stage par, taake tasveeron ko jaise chahein tarteeb se rakhein.

Dekhein! Yeh kachhua maine sirf shaklon se banaya hai!
Har shakl ke number badal kar dekhein. Aap unhein hila sakte hain, bada chhota kar sakte hain, aur ghuma bhi sakte hain.
Khel kar dekhein ke aap kya kuch bana sakte hain!

\
¶Note: Tasveerein ek ke upar ek lagane ki aik aur mansooba <misaal@https://wordplay.dev/project/example-Layers?play> ke liye numaish gah dekhein.¶


Stage(
	[
		Shakal(Gol(3m 0m 1m 0m))
		Shakal(Kaseerulazlaa(2m 3 0m -12m 0m) ghumaao: -30°)
		Shakal(Kaseerulazlaa(7m 6 0m -6m 0m))
		Shakal(Mustateel(-11m -9m 11m -12m 10m) ghumaao: 25°)
		Shakal(Mustateel(-11m -9m 11m -12m 10m) ghumaao: -25°)

	]
	jagah: Jagah(0m 10m -30m)
)
\

 Aap tahon se waqai bohat zabardast cheezein bana sakte hain! Aazmaa kar dekhein!

title: Poore stage ko purani film, television ya paani jaisa dikhayein
body:
Filmon mein poore manzar ka andaaz badal jaata hai: guzra hua waqia naram aur roshan ho jaata hai, purani khabron ki reel par khuraunchein aur dhundla pan hota hai, television par shor ki lakeerein aati hain, aur paani ke neeche har cheez lehrati hai aur neeli ho jaati hai.
Hum yehi kaam kar sakte hain jab hum @Stage ko @Effect na ho.

Yeh paani mein se dekha hua manzar hai.

\
Stage(
	[Jumla('🐠') Jumla('🌿' jagah: Jagah(1m -1m))]
	asraat: [Lehar(0.15m) Rangat(Rang(55% 45 220°) 70%) Dhund(40% Rang(70% 30 200°))]
)
\

 Har asar sirf ek kaam karta hai. @Wave lehrein banata hai, @Tint har cheez ko ek hi rang mein rang deta hai, aur @Haze us par behti hui dhund bichha deta hai.
Yeh sab mil kar paani jaise lagte hain. Asar usi tarteeb se lagte hain jis tarteeb se woh likhe hon, is liye baad wala asar pehle walon ke nateeje ko badal deta hai.

Milane ke liye das asar hain: @Blur, @Grade, @Tint, @Haze, @Grain, @Scanlines, @Wave, @Damage, @Flicker, aur @Vignette na ho.
Yeh ek purani film hai: @Grade rang khatam kar deta hai, phir @Damage, @Grain, aur @Flicker use ghisa hua aur larakhta hua bana dete hain.

\
Stage(
	[Jumla('KHATAM')]
	asraat: [Darja(tazaad: 130% rangeeni: 0%) Nuqsaan(70% 50%) Daanay(25%) Jhilmilahat(15% 2) Kinaaray(60%)]
)
\

 Aur yeh ek television hai jis ka signal ja raha hai.

\
Stage(
	[Jumla('channel 3')]
	asraat: [Lakeerein(40% raftaar: 1) Daanay(50% size: 2) Jhilmilahat(20%)]
)
\

 Kisi andaaz ko baar baar istemaal karne ke liye ek function banayein jo asar ki fehrist wapas de.
Is ke inputs us andaaz ki apni settings ban jaate hain. Yeh wala jitna gehra jayein utna dhundla hota jaata hai.

\
ƒ paaniKeNeeche(gehraai2•%) [
	Lehar(0.2m · gehraai2)
	Rangat(Rang(55% 45 220°) gehraai2)
	Dhundla(0.03m · gehraai2)
]

Stage([Jumla('🐠')] asraat: paaniKeNeeche(80%))
\

 Ek andaaz khel ki haalat ke saath bhi badal sakta hai.
Yahan jab khiladi ki sirf ek jaan bachti hai to stage dhundla aur kinaron par andhera ho jaata hai, aur jab zyada jaanein hon to dobara saaf ho jaata hai.

\
zindagiyan: 3 … ∆ Kunji() … zindagiyan - 1

Stage(
	[Jumla(zindagiyan → '')]
	asraat: zindagiyan < 2 ? [Dhundla(0.05m) Kinaaray(70% Rang(30% 80 30°))] []
)
\

 Asar stage par maujood cheezon ko dhakte hain, lekin us ke @Stage.overlay ko kabhi nahin, is liye score ya button saaf parhne mein aata hai.

Poore stage ko hilana, jaise zalzala, koi asar nahin hai: ek @Stage kisi bhi doosre output ki tarah hil sakta hai, is liye use ek @Sequence na ho.

\
Stage([Jumla('🏠')] rukna: Silsila.hilna(0.5s ginti: 4x))
\

 Kuch asar tezi se hilte hain. Jab kisi ne apne device se harkat kam karne ko kaha ho, to har asar ruka rehta hai.
@Flicker kabhi ek second mein chand baar se zyada nahin chamakta, chahe aap kitni hi tezi maangein, kyunki tez chamak logon ko nuqsan pohancha sakti hai.

title: Kirdaar ko hilaayein
body:
Kabhi kabhi kirdaar ko kaanptay hue dikhana faaida mand hota hai.
Aisa karne ke kai tareeqay hain.

Hum istemaal kar sakte hain @Phrase/offset ke saath @Random aur @Time taake aisa ho jaye.

\
hataHua: 0m … ∆ Waqt() … Ittefaqi(-0.1m 0.1m)
Jumla('salaam' hatao: Jagah(hataHua 0m))
\

 Yeh ek qeemat banata hai jiska naam hai \offset\ jo har baar ghari ke chalne par ek naye random qeemat mein badal jati hai.
Phir yeh us offset ko istemaal karke dikhata hai @Phrase ko utni hi offset ke saath.

Agar hum hilne ko aur behtar tareeqay se qaaboo karna chahein, to hum istemaal kar sakte hain ek @Sequence taake ek random hilne wali animation banayein jo dohraati rahe.

\
Jumla('salaam' rukna: Silsila({
			0%: Andaaz(hatao: Jagah(Ittefaqi(-.2m .2m)))
			15%: Andaaz(hatao: Jagah(Ittefaqi(-.2m .2m)))
			60%: Andaaz(hatao: Jagah(Ittefaqi(-.2m .2m)))
			75%: Andaaz(hatao: Jagah(Ittefaqi(-.2m .2m)))
		} 0.1s))
\

 Yeh misaal sirf ek baar random qeematein chunti hai, lekin unhein ek dohraane wali tarteeb mein badal deti hai.

title: Camera se video banayein
body:
Yeh @Camera dhaara duniya se rangon ka jaal hasil karne ka bohat acha tareeqa hai. 
Agar hum un rangon ko dekhna chahein aur woh tasveer dobara banayein jo @Camera dekhta hai, to kya karein?

Ek @Image rangon ka jaal leta hai aur use ek tasveer ki shakal mein banata hai, is liye hum use @Camera ke rang seedhe de sakte hain.

\
chauraai: 24
unchaai2: 24
colors2: Camera(chauraai × 1px unchaai2 × 1px 33ms)
Stage([Tasveer(colors2 'camera jo dekhta hai' 12m)])
\

 Har @Image ko ek wazahat chahiye, kyunke rangon ke jaal ke paas apne koi alfaaz nahin hote jo us shakhs ke kaam aayein jo dekh nahin sakta.

Hum tasveer ko khaanon ki bajaye huroof se bana sakte hain, is ke liye use ek / glyph / dein, yaani ek function jo ek rang ko us matn mein badalta hai jo us rang ki numaindagi karta hai.

\
chauraai: 24
unchaai2: 24
colors2: Camera(chauraai × 1px unchaai2 × 1px 33ms)
Stage([Tasveer(colors2 'camera, jo gehre aur halke daairon se banaya gaya hai' 12m nishaan: ƒ(rang3•Rang) (rang3.ujaala < 50%) ? "⬤" "◯")])
\

title: Points ka hisaab rakhein
body:
Kabhi kabhi game mein jab kuch hota hai to points ka hisaab rakhna madadgaar hota hai. Agar @wordplay mutaghayyar ko nayi qeemat dene ki ijaazat nahin deta, to hum yeh kaise karein?

Is ki tarkeeb yeh hai ke @Reaction istemaal karke @Bind ki qeemat tay karein, aur dhyaan se sochein ke kaunsa waqia is ki nayi qeemat banaye. @Bind na ho.

Misaal ke taur par, ek bohat saada game sochein jismein khilaadi jitni baar keyboard par koi khufiya kunji dabata hai, utne zyada points paata hai. 

\
points2: 0 … ['a' 'e' 'i' 'o' 'u'].rakhta(Kunji()) … points2 + 1
\

 Yeh misaal kehti hai, / Points 0 se shuru hote hain, aur phir jab bhi koi kunji dabayi jaye, agar woh kunji vowels ki list mein ho, to points maujooda points se ek zyada ho jate hain./ Jab bhi \Kunji()\ dhaara badalti hai, program dobara chalta hai, shart jaanchta hai, aur agar woh sahi ho to \points\ ko nayi qeemat deta hai.

Is mein reaction ke teen hisse hain:

• Points ki shuruati qeemat (\0\)
• Woh shart jo sahi hone par nayi qeemat banati hai (\['a' 'e' 'i' 'o' 'u'].rakhta(Kunji())\)
• Nayi qeemat, agar shart sahi ho jaye (\points + 1\)

Points ka hisaab rakhne ka zyada behtar tareeqa banane ke liye, bas zyada mazboot shartein ya nayi qeematein banayein. Un shartein aur nayi qeematon ke usool par thoda waqt sochein, aur phir unhein code mein likhne ki koshish karein.

title: Khel ki haalat ka hisaab rakhein
body:
Zyaadatar khel, jaise jaise aage barhte hain, kai cheezon ka hisaab rakhte hain: points, khilaadi ki jagah, aur doosri tafseelaat sab zaroori hain.
Jab bhi koi input aata hai, haalat badal jaati hai, aur phir hum jawab mein naya output dikhana chahte hain.

Kisi bhi khel ka aam tareeqa teen kaam karta hai:

• Khel ki haalat ka data structure banayein, jo khel ki saari haalat ko mehfooz rakhe
• Ek reaction banayein jo har naye input par pichhli khel ki haalat se nayi khel ki haalat banaye
• Ek banayein @Stage jis mein @Group aur @Phrase ho, taake khel ki haalat dikhai de

Misaal ke taur par, ek aasaan khel sochein jis mein text box mein khufiya alfaaz likhne hote hain, aur har baar khufiya lafz bujhne par ek point milta hai:

\
•khel(raaz•[''] points2•#)

haalat: khel(['billi' 'kutta'] 0) … haalat.raaz.rakhta(Guftagu()) … haalat.points2: haalat.points2 + 1

Stage(
    haalat.points2 = haalat.raaz.lambaai() ? 
        [ Jumla('aap jeet gaye!')]
        [ Group(Tah() [ Jumla('mere khufiya alfaaz boojhein') Jumla(`\haalat.raaz.lambaai() - haalat.points2\ aur raaz`)])]
)
\

 Aaiye ise samajhte hain.

• Pehli line, \•khel(raaz•[''] points2•#)\ kehti hai, / Ek data structure banayein jiska naam \Game\ ho aur jo khufiya alfaaz ki list aur points rakhta ho /. \['']\ ka matlab hai / kisi bhi tadaad ke alfaaz ki list /. Agar aap ek khaas lambai ki list chahte hain, to aap us ki har jagah ke liye ek qism ka naam likh sakte hain: \[# '']\ do cheezon ki list hai, pehle ek number phir ek lafz.
• Doosri line kehti hai / Khel ki haalat khufiya alfaaz ki list aur sifar points se shuru hoti hai. Jab bhi \Guftagu\ badalta hai, agar likha gaya lafz khufiya alfaaz ki list mein hai, to nayi khel ki haalat banayein jis mein points ek se barh jayein / par ruk jaata hai.
• Jab bhi program dobara chalta hai (jab \Guftagu\ badalta hai), toh ek stage dikhayein. Agar points ki tadaad raazon ki tadaad ke barabar ho, toh jeetne wala stage dikhayein. Agar nahin, toh ek paigham aur baqi raazon ki tadaad dikhayein.

Is misaal mein kuch masle hain:

• Agar woh ek raaz wale lafz ko kai baar bataein, toh unhein zyada points milte hain! Hamari game ki haalat ko yeh bhi yaad rakhna pad sakta hai ke kya bataya gaya, taake har lafz sirf ek baar gina jaye.
• Agar khilaari kai alfaaz likhe, toh kya woh gine jayein?

Zyada behtar game ki haalatein aur game ke updates in masalon ko sambhalne mein hamari madad karenge.

title: Chuni ja sakne wali ikhtiyaarat dikhayein
body:
Kabhi kabhi aap screen par bohat se ikhtiyaarat dikhana chahte hain, aur dekhne walon ke chune hue ikhtiyaar ke mutabiq kuch karna chahte hain. Iske liye hamein do cheezein chahiye:

• Ek ya zyada @Phrase jo chuni ja sakne wali hon aur jin ka alag naam ho (misaal ke taur par, \Jumla('intekhaab 1' chunaJaSakneWala naam: 'ek')\)
• Us content ki ek @Choice, jo sab se aakhir mein chune gaye @Phrase ke naam mein badal jata hai.

Misaal ke taur par, yahan hum teen ikhtiyaarat dikhate hain, har ek ka alag naam hai.

\
intikhaab: Intikhaab()

Group(
	Tah() [
		Jumla('intekhaab 1' chunaJaSakneWala naam: 'ek')
		Jumla('intekhaab 2' chunaJaSakneWala naam: 'do')
		Jumla('intekhaab 3' chunaJaSakneWala naam: 'teen')
		Jumla(intikhaab)
	]
)
\

 Jab bhi koi ek chuna jata hai, aakhir mein chuna gaya @Phrase chuna hua naam dikhata hai.

Aap is tareeqe se kisi ikhtiyaar ke jawab mein kaam karwa sakte hain. Misaal ke taur par, hum upar wali mansooba ko badal kar chune hue ikhtiyaar ke mutabiq ek posheeda emoji dikha sakte hain:

\
intikhaab: Intikhaab()

intikhaab = '' ?
	Group(
		Tah() [
			Jumla('intekhaab 1' chunaJaSakneWala: ⊤ naam: 'one')
			Jumla('intekhaab 2' chunaJaSakneWala: ⊤ naam: 'two')
			Jumla('intekhaab 3' chunaJaSakneWala: ⊤ naam: 'three')
		]
	)
	Jumla(
		{
			'one': '😡'
			'two': '🏀'
			'three': '❤'
		}{intikhaab} ?? '?'
	)
\

 Yeh @Choice khaali @Text se shuru hota hai, is liye jab mansooba shuru hoti hai to hum yeh jaanchte hain, aur teen ikhtiyaarat dikhate hain.
Jab ikhtiyaar chun liya jata hai, to yeh teen @Phrase naamon mein se ek ban jata hai.

Chune hue ikhtiyaar ke mutabiq emoji dikhane ke liye hum ek @Map istemaal kar sakte hain jo naam ko posheeda emoji mein badal de.
Jab hum @Map se koi qeemat hasil karte hain aur koi mel nahin milta, to woh \ø\ ban jati hai, is liye hum \??\ istemaal karte hain taake agar ikhtiyaar map mein na ho to \'?'\ par aa jaye. 
Is misaal mein aisa kabhi nahin ho sakta, lekin hum itne samajhdaar nahin ke yeh jaan sakein!

title: Ek text adventure banayein
body:
Khel ki ek mazedaar qism / apna adventure khud chunein / khel hai, jahan khilari kai faislon se guzarta hai aur khushi bhare anjaam tak pahunchne ka raasta dhoondta hai. 

Aisa khel banane ke liye hum in sab ko istemaal kar sakte hain: @Structure, @Key, @Reaction, aur @List ko saath mila kar faislon ka ek majmua banayein, jis mein har faisle ke kuch options hon, jaise yeh:

\¶Yeh ek data structure banata hai jo ek intikhaab ko yaad rakhta hai aur yeh bhi ke woh kis faisle par le jaayega¶
•ikhtiyaar(matn2•'' faisla•#)

¶Yeh data structure intikhaabat ki ek list rakhta hai¶
•faisla2(ikhtiyaarat: [ikhtiyaar])

¶Yeh khel ka mawaad hai! Ikhtiyaarat mein matn badlein taake mahaul banay aur mushkil intikhaabat saamne aayein. Ikhtiyaarat shamil karein taake mushkil intikhaabat ka ek jaal ban jaye.¶
faisle: [
		faisla2([ikhtiyaar('aaghaz' 2)])
		faisla2(
			[
				ikhtiyaar('baayein' 3)
				ikhtiyaar('seedha' 4)
				ikhtiyaar('daayein' 4)
			]
		)
		faisla2([ikhtiyaar('jeet' 1)])
		faisla2([ikhtiyaar('haar' 1)])
	]

¶Kunji ko number mein badlein, agar woh number ho¶
kunji2: Kunji()
intikhaab: kunji2 → #

¶Yeh qeemat upar di gayi list mein maujooda faisle ko zaahir karti hai. Jab kunji dabayi jaye, to hum neeche diye gaye mein se ek kaam karte hain. Agar is faisle ke liye sirf ek intikhaab hai, to hum maujooda faisle ko ikhtiyaar ke hadaf wale faisle par badal dete hain, chahe koi bhi kunji dabayi gayi ho. Agar dabayi gayi kunji 1 aur ikhtiyaarat ki tadaad ke darmiyan hai, to hum us ikhtiyaar ke hadaf wale faisle par jaate hain. Warna, hum maujooda faisle ko waisa hi rehne dete hain.¶
maujooda•#: 1 …
	∆ kunji2 …
		faisle[maujooda].ikhtiyaarat.lambaai() = 1 ?
			faisle[maujooda].ikhtiyaarat[1].faisla
			((1 ‥ faisle[maujooda].ikhtiyaarat.lambaai()) ∋ intikhaab) ?
				faisle[maujooda].ikhtiyaarat[intikhaab].faisla
				maujooda

¶Yeh ikhtiyaarat ko jumlon ke ek dhaanche ki surat mein dikhata hai. Aap ismein hidayaat, animations aur doosri dilchasp cheezein shamil kar sakte hain!¶
Stage(
	[
		Group(
			Tah()
			faisle[maujooda].ikhtiyaarat.badlo(
				ƒ(ikhtiyaar2) Jumla(ikhtiyaar2.matn2)
			)
		)
	]
)

\

 Yeh tareeqa mushkil lagta hai, lekin yeh sirf itna karta hai ke maujooda options dikhata hai aur jab bhi koi kunji badalti hai, to chune hue option ke faisle par chala jata hai. Khel banana sab se oopar ka maazmoon badalne ka naam hai!

title: Harkat ko dohraana
body:
Kabhi kabhi hum chahte hain ke koi kirdar kai baar ek hi tarah harkat kare! 
Wahi lines baar baar likhna thakaa dene wala ho sakta hai.

Is ke bajaye, hum @Sequence ke saath @Phrase istemaal kar ke kisi cheez ko kai baar dohra sakte hain! Khaas taur par,
hum @Sequence mein gintii istemaal kar sakte hain aur chun sakte hain ke poses ka ek set kitni baar ho. Misaal ke taur par, 
yeh ek basketball hai jo do baar oopar neeche uchhal raha hai. 

\
Stage([
	Jumla('🏀' aana: Silsila({
				0%: Andaaz(hatao: Jagah(y: 0.25m))
				25%: Andaaz(hatao: Jagah(y: 0m))
				50%: Andaaz(hatao: Jagah(y: -0.25m))
				75%: Andaaz(hatao: Jagah(y: 0m))
				100%: Andaaz(hatao: Jagah(y: 0.25m))} ginti:2x muddat:2s))
])
\

title: Matn ko ek saath saath rakhein
body:
Kabhi kabhi hum chahte hain ke matn ek doosre ke saath ek saaf lakeer mein baithe.
Hum yeh is se kar sakte hain: @Row, jo sab kuch ek @Group mein baayen se daayen tarteeb deta hai.

\
Group(Qataar() [
    Jumla('🍎')
    Jumla('🍌')
    Jumla('🍇')
])
\

 Ek @Row huroof ko unke oopar, beech, ya neeche ke kinaaron se bhi barabar kar sakta hai, aur unke darmiyaan jagah bhi daal sakta hai.
Yeh wahi phal hai, lekin neeche se barabar kiya gaya hai aur thodi khuli jagah ke saath:

\
Group(Qataar('>' 0.5m) [
    Jumla('🍎' size: 2m)
    Jumla('🍌' size: 1m)
    Jumla('🍇' size: 3m)
])
\

 Yeh \'>'\  @Row ko batata hai ke sab kuch apne neeche ke kinaare par barabar karo. Aazmaayein \'<'\ oopar ke liye ya \'|'\ beech ke liye.
Yeh \0.5m\ har harf ke darmiyaan ki jagah hai.

title: Huroof ko upar se neeche jamaein
body:
Agar @Row saath saath rakhne ke liye hai, to @Stack upar se neeche rakhne ke liye hai.
@Stack har harf ko pichhle harf ke neeche rakhta hai, ek meenaar ki tarah.

\
Group(Tah() [
    Jumla('ek')
    Jumla('do')
    Jumla('teen')
])
\

 Jaise @Row, @Stack mein bhi sath aur khaali jagah ho sakti hai.
Sab kuch baayein kinaare ke saath milane ki koshish karein:

\
Group(Tah('<' 0.25m) [
    Jumla('🐣 chhota')
    Jumla('🐥 darmiyana')
    Jumla('🐔 bara')
])
\

 Yeh \'<'\ ka matlab hai / sab kuch baayein kinaare ke saath milayein / na ho.
Aap \'|'\ darmiyan ke liye ya \'>'\ daayein kinaare ke liye bhi aazma sakte hain.

title: Huroof ka jaal banayein
body:
Agar hum qataarein / aur / sutoon ek hi waqt mein chahein to? Iske liye @Grid hota hai.

Ek @Grid qataaron ki tadaad, sutoon ki tadaad, aur khaanon ke darmiyaan kitni jagah chhorni hai, yeh poochta hai.

\
Group(Jaal(2 3 0.25m) [
    Jumla('🍎') Jumla('🍌') Jumla('🍇')
    Jumla('🥕') Jumla('🥦') Jumla('🌽')
])
\

 Yeh 2 by 3 ka phal aur sabzi ka baagh banata hai!

Agar aap chahte hain ke har khaana ek hi naap ka ho, to @Grid ko chaudaai aur unchaai bhi dein. Is tarah huroof apne chaukor khaanon ke andar saaf suthre rehte hain, chahe woh alag alag naap ke hon:

\
Group(Jaal(2 2 0.1m 1.5m 1.5m) [
    Jumla('🐈' size: 1m)
    Jumla('🐶' size: 1.5m)
    Jumla('🦊' size: 0.5m)
    Jumla('🐻' size: 2m)
])
\

title: Kisi harf ya shakal ki bohat si nakalein banayein
body:
Agar hamein das billiyan ya sau sitare chahiye hon, lekin hum un sab ko ek ek kar ke likhna na chahein to?
Hum ek list se kah sakte hain ke woh hamare liye nakalein bana de, is ke zariye @List/translate na ho.

Agar hum is number se shuru karein \10\ aur use is se badal dein \→ []\, to hamein 1 se 10 tak das numbron ki ek list mil jaati hai.
Phir hum is ko istemaal karte hain @List/translate taake har number ko ek mein badal sakein @Phrase deta hai:

\
Group(Qataar() (10 → []).badlo(ƒ() Jumla('🐈')))
\

@List/translate hamare chhote se function ko har rukn ke liye ek baar chalata hai, aur nateejon ko ek nayi list mein jama kar deta hai.

Har nakal ko thoda alag banane ke liye, woh number istemaal karein jo translate hamein deta hai:

\
Group(Qataar('|' 0.2m) [:1‥8].badlo(ƒ(n4) Jumla('⭐' size: n4 × 0.5m)))
\

 Har sitara pichhle se bada hai, kyunke \n\ is se shuru hota hai \1\ aur is tak jaata hai \8\ na ho.

title: Ek kirdaar ko apni ungli ke peeche chalaein
body:
Kya aap chahte hain ke ek kirdaar aapke mouse ya ungli ka peecha kare, poore @Stage?
Hum yeh is ke saath kar sakte hain: @Pointer input.

@Pointer hamein har baar ek naya @Place deta hai jab pointer hilta hai.
Agar hum is @Place ko @Phrase ki \place\ bana dein, to kirdaar wahin jayega jahan hum ishaara karein.

\
Stage([Jumla('🐈' jagah: Nishaana())] jagah: Jagah(0m 0m -10m))
\

 Bas itna hi! Apna mouse hilaein ya ungli ghumaein, aur billi ko peeche aate dekhein.

Aap aur dilchasp cheezein kar sakte hain agar is mein se \x\ aur \y\ ko @Place na ho.
Yeh ek batakh hai jo hamesha pointer se ek meter upar tairta rehta hai:

\
Stage([Jumla('🦆' jagah: Jagah(Nishaana().x Nishaana().y + 1m))] jagah: Jagah(0m 0m -10m))
\

title: Apna khud ka character template banayein
body:
Kabhi kabhi aap ko bohat saare character chahiye hote hain jo lagbhag ek jaise dikhte hain, lekin un mein chhote chhote farq hote hain.
Ek hi cheez ko baar baar likhne ke bajaye, aap @Phrase ke zariye apna template bana sakte hain. Template ek nuskhe ki tarah hai jis mein khaali jagahein bharni hoti hain. @Structure par ruk jaata hai.

Ek @Structure ek nuskhe ki tarah hai jis mein khaali jagahein bharni hoti hain.
Yeh ek ghubbare ka template hai jo rang aur label leta hai, aur apne aap ko dikhana jaanta hai:

\
•ghubbara(rang3•Rang parchi•'') (
    ƒ dikhayein() Jumla(`🎈 \parchi\` rang: rang3 size: 2m)
)

Group(Qataar() [
    ghubbara(Rang(80% 50 240°) 'Aasmaan').dikhayein()
    ghubbara(Rang(60% 80 0°) 'Gulaab').dikhayein()
    ghubbara(Rang(90% 80 90°) 'Dhoop').dikhayein()
])
\

 Yeh \•Balloon(...)\ hissa template ko tay karta hai, aur \ƒ dikhayein()\ hissa batata hai / ek ko kaise banana hai / par ruk jaata hai.
Phir hum alag alag rang aur label ke teen ghubbare banate hain, aur har ek se kehte hain ke woh khud ko \show\ kare.

Jab aap apna code saaf suthra aur apne character ek jaise rakhna chahein, tab templates bohat kaam aate hain.

title: Waqt guzarne ke saath ginti barhayein
body:
Bohat si mansoobon mein aisi cheez chahiye hoti hai jo waqt ke saath barhti hai, jaise timer, score ya ulti ginti.
Hum ek counter bana sakte hain jab hum is dhaara ko jodein @Time dhaara ke saath ek @Reaction na ho.

Ek @Reaction ke teen hisse hote hain: ek aaghaazi qeemat, dekhne ke liye ek cheez, aur ek naya qeemat jab woh cheez badalti hai.
Yahan hum shuru karte hain \0\ se, dekhte hain @Time, aur har baar ghari tik karne par ek jama karte hain:

\
ginti: 0 … ∆ Time(1000ms) … ginti + 1
Phrase(ginti → '')
\

 Har second, @Time chalta hai, aur @Reaction isay dekh leta hai \∆ Time(1000ms)\, aur \count\ ban jata hai \count + 1\ na ho.
Yeh \→ ''\ aakhir mein number ko matn mein badal deta hai taake @Phrase isay dikha sake.

Aap koi bhi input istemaal kar sakte hain, sirf waqt hi nahin. Yeh counter Button() ke dabaaye jaane ki tadaad ginta hai:

\
ginti: 0 … ∆ Button() … ginti + 1
Phrase(ginti → '')
\

 Jab bhi @Button dhaara click ya tap se badalti hai, ginti ek se barh jati hai.

title: Kisi doosre shehar ka waqt dikhayein
body:
@Now mojooda tareekh aur waqt ko ek aisi qeemat ki shakal mein dhaara banata hai jo @Moment hoti hai, aur Moment ko matn mein badalne se woh aapke ilaaqe ke mutabiq saja diya jata hai. Is tarah ghari sirf ek line ke code se ban jati hai:

\Phrase(Now() → '')\

 Kisi aur jagah ka waqt chahiye? @Now ko ek time zone dein. Time zone ke naam ilaaqe aur shehar se bante hain, jaise \'America/New_York'\, \'Europe/Paris'\, ya \'Asia/Tokyo'\. Aap matn ki qism ke baad ek zubaan bhi likh sakte hain, jaise \''/ja\ jo Japani ke liye hai, taake ghari us shehar ki zubaan mein dikhe:

\Phrase(Now(1s 'Asia/Tokyo') → ''/ja)\

 Time zone ka naam nahin pata? Bas koi shehar likh dein jise aap jaante hain — @wordplay aapko bataye ga ke yeh time zone nahin hai aur sab se qareebi naam bhi sujhaye ga, taake aap ek click se isay theek kar sakein.

Aap koi calendar bhi chun sakte hain, jaise Japani calendar, aur ghari ko font se saja sakte hain:

\Phrase(Now(1s 'Asia/Tokyo' 'japanese') → '' khat: 'Doto')\

title: Awaaz se kirdaaron ko bada karein
body:
Kya aap jaante hain ke aapki mansooba aapki baat sun sakti hai? @Volume dhaara aapke microphone se ek number deti hai, jo \0\ (khaamosh) se \1\ (tez) tak hota hai.

Hum is number se kuch bhi qaabu kar sakte hain — jaise @Phrase ka size, uska ghoomna, uska rang.

\
Phrase('📣' size: (Volume() × 5m) + 1m)
\

 Jab khaamoshi ho, to megaphone \1m\ lamba hota hai. Jab aap cheekhte hain, to woh \6m\ tak lamba ho sakta hai.

Kya aap ek aisa sooraj chahte hain jo aapki awaaz jitni tez ho, utna tez ghoome?

\
Phrase('🌞' ghumaao: Volume() × 360°)
\

 Taali bajaein ya gunguna kar dekhein, aur dekhein ke kya hota hai.
(Pehli baar aapka computer microphone istemaal karne ki ijaazat maang sakta hai.)

title: Fehrist se koi bhi cheez ittefaq se chunein
body:
Kya aap chahte hain ke aap ki mansooba har baar chalne par aap ko hairaan kare? Intikhabaat ki ek fehrist banayein aur us mein se ek chunein @Random na ho.

@Random hamein ek ittefaqi number de sakta hai, aur fehrist mein number se cheez dhoondi ja sakti hai \[n]\ na ho.
In dono ko mila kar ek ittefaqi emoji chunein:

\
emoji: ['🌈' '🌟' '🎈' '🦄' '🍩']
Jumla(emoji.ittefaqi())
\

 Aap yeh bhi istemaal kar sakte hain @Random do numbers ke saath, jo un ke darmiyan ka ek poora number chunta hai.
Misaal ke taur par, har second / naya / ittefaqi emoji chunne ke liye, yeh milayein @Time aur ek @Reaction deta hai:

\
emoji: ['🌈' '🌟' '🎈' '🦄' '🍩']
chunein: emoji[1] … ∆ Waqt(1000ms) … emoji[Ittefaqi(1 emoji.lambaai())]
Jumla(chunein)
\

 Har tick par @Time, yeh @Reaction ek naya hairaan kun nateeja chunta hai.

title: Qeemat ke mutabiq mukhtalif cheezein dikhayein
body:
Agar aap chahte hain ke @Phrase kisi cheez ke mutabiq badal jaye, jaise score ya kisi kunji ka dabna, to kya karein?

Hum shartiya \?\ istemaal kar ke do cheezon mein se ek chun sakte hain.
Pehle shart likhein, phir \?\, phir woh qeemat jo shart sahi hone par istemaal ho, phir woh qeemat jo shart ghalat hone par istemaal ho.

Yeh ek khush chehra hai jo har baar space bar dabane par udaas ho jata hai, aur phir dobara khush ho jata hai:

\
khush: ⊤ … ∆ Kunji(' ') … ~khush
Jumla(khush ? '😊' '😢')
\

 Yeh @Reaction shuru mein \happy\ ke tor par \⊤\ (sahi) hota hai, aur isay \~\ se palat deta hai jab bhi space dabaya jaye.
Phir shartiya \?\ sahi chehra chun leta hai.

Aap shartiya izhaar ko jod kar do se zyada cheezon mein se chun sakte hain:

\
score: 0 … ∆ Kunji('a') … score + 1
Jumla(score < 3 ? '🥚' score < 6 ? '🐣' '🐥')
\

 Kuch baar \a\ dabayein aur dekhein ke anda phoot kar chooza ban jata hai!

title: Kirdaar ko girne aur uchhalne wala banayein
body:
Agar hum chahein ke koi kirdaar neeche gire, farsh se uchhle, ya asli cheez ki tarah dhakka khaye to kya karein?
Is ke liye yeh hain: @Motion aur @Matter — yeh mil kar ek @Phrase na ho.

@Motion ki physics chalate hain. Yeh tay karta hai ke kirdaar waqt ke saath / kahan / hai. Hum ise \place\ ke liye @Phrase ke tor par istemaal karte hain, aur ise unchaai se shuru karte hain taake yeh gire.
Hamein girne ke liye koi cheez bhi chahiye, warna hamara kirdaar hamesha girta hi rahega! Ek chauda @Shape wala @Rectangle achha farsh ban jata hai:

\
Stage([
    Jumla('🍎' jagah: Harkat(Jagah(0m 5m)) maadda: Maadda())
    Shakal(Mustateel(-10m 0m 10m -5m))
])
\

 Seb paanch meter unchaai se shuru hota hai aur gurutvakarshan se girta hai.
Jab yeh farsh se takrata hai to thoda uchhalta hai, kyunki @Phrase mein ek pehle se maujood @Matter hota hai jo tay karta hai ke yeh kitna bhaari aur uchhalne wala hai.

Kirdaar kitna / uchhalne wala / ya kitna / bhaari / hai, yeh badalne ke liye usay apna @Matter na ho.
@Matter dein. Yeh wazan, uchhaal aur ragad leta hai:

\
Stage([
    Jumla('⚽' jagah: Harkat(Jagah(-2m 5m)) maadda: Maadda(1kg 0.9 0.2))
    Jumla('🪨' jagah: Harkat(Jagah(2m 5m)) maadda: Maadda(5kg 0.1 0.8))
    Shakal(Mustateel(-10m 0m 10m -5m))
])
\

 Gend halki aur uchhalne wali hai, is liye woh wapas uchhal jati hai.
Patthar bhaari hai aur uchhalta nahin, is liye woh bas dham se gir jata hai.

title: Kai zubaanon ke dekhne walon ko salaam karein
body:
Ek @Phrase har dekhne wale ko uski chuni hui zubaanon ke mutabiq theek tarjuma dikhata hai. Agar aapke dekhne wale Spanish bolte hain, to aap unse Spanish mein baat kar sakte hain; agar woh Spanish aur English dono bolte hain — Spanglish! — to aap dono milaa sakte hain.

Ek @TextLiteral ko kai tarjume dein, jin mein ek kai zubaanon wala bhi ho, aur @wordplay har dekhne wale ke liye sab se munasib tarjuma chun leta hai:

\
Phrase("hola"/es"hello"/en"hola gentleman"/es_en)
\

 Jis dekhne wale ki pasandeeda zubaan sirf Spanish hai, woh yeh dekhta hai: / hola /. Jo sirf English pasand karta hai, woh yeh dekhta hai: / hello /. Jo Spanish aur English dono pasand karta hai, woh yeh dekhta hai: / hola gentleman / — yaani Spanglish wala tarjuma.

Wordplay sab se khaas mel ko tarjeeh deta hai, is liye jab dono lagu ho sakte hon to ek zubaan wala tarjuma hamesha kai zubaanon wale tarjume par ghalib aata hai.

Spanglish wala tarjuma poora Spanish mein parha jaata hai, yaani apni pehli zubaan mein. Har lafz ko uski apni zubaan mein parhwane ke liye, hissaon par alag alag tag lagayein aur unhein jodein:

\
Phrase("hola "/es + "gentleman"/en)
\

title: Har harf ko apna alag rang dein
body:
Ek @Phrase apne har glyph ko alag rang de sakta hai @Pose ke saath @Phrase/poses na ho.
Pehle glyph ko pehla pose milta hai, doosre glyph ko doosra, aur jab poses khatam ho jaate hain, to woh dobara pehle se shuru ho jaate hain.

Yeh party wala matn hai, jis mein teen rang baari baari aate hain:

\
Jumla(
	'party ka waqt!'
	khat: 'Luckiest Guy'
	adaayen: [
		Andaaz(rang: Rang(25% 70 250°))
		Andaaz(rang: Rang(50% 80 300°))
		Andaaz(rang: Rang(58% 90 60°))
	]
)
\

 Khaali jagah bhi glyph gini jaati hai, is liye rang alfaaz ke beech bhi baari baari aate rehte hain.
Yeh rang hue ke saath saath roshni mein bhi mukhtalif hain, is liye jo log rang alag tarah se dekhte hain woh bhi inhein alag pehchaan sakte hain.

Poses sirf rang se zyada kaam kar sakte hain. Har glyph apne beech ke gird tirchha hota hai, bada hota hai, dhundla hota hai aur hilta hai, is liye hum harf ko uchhalta hua bana sakte hain:

\
Jumla(
	'uchhalna'
	khat: 'Luckiest Guy'
	adaayen: [
		Andaaz(rang: Rang(25% 70 250°) ghumaao: -10° hatao: Jagah(0m 0.1m))
		Andaaz(rang: Rang(58% 90 60°) ghumaao: 10° dhundlapan: 0.6)
	]
)
\

 Poses saje hue matn ke saath bhi chalte hain, aur kisi bhi doosre input ki tarah, woh doosri qeematon ke mutabiq badal sakte hain.
Yeh ransom note har chauthai second mein naya jhukaao chunta hai:

\
jhukao2: 0° … ∆ Waqt(250ms) … Ittefaqi(-15° 15°)
Jumla(
	`*ransom* /note/`
	khat: 'Courier Prime'
	adaayen: [
		Andaaz(ghumaao: jhukao2 hatao: Jagah(0m 0.05m))
		Andaaz(ghumaao: -jhukao2 paimaana: 1.2)
		Andaaz(ghumaao: jhukao2 ÷ 2 hatao: Jagah(0m -0.05m))
	]
)
\

title: Patterns se matn talaash karein aur jaanchein
body:
Pattern kisi matn ki shakal bayaan karta hai, taake aap jaanch saken ke matn us shakal se milta hai ya nahin, ya har us jagah ko talaash kar saken jahan woh aata hai. Patterns is ke andar likhe jaate hain: \⣿ ⣿\ aur baayen se daayen, ek ek hissa karke parhe jaate hain. \_\ ek harf hai, \#\ ek hindsa hai, \␣\ ek khaali jagah hai, aur likha hua matn jaise \"-"\ bilkul wahi milta hai.

Yeh jaanchne ke liye ke poora matn kisi pattern se milta hai ya nahin, \≈\ istemaal karein, jo aap ko ek \?\ deta hai:

\
'AB-1234' ≈ ⣿2 _ "-" 4 #⣿
\

 Yeh poochta hai: dau huroof, ek lakeer, phir chaar hindse? Aur jawab hai \⊤\ na ho.

Ginti us cheez se pehle aati hai jise woh dohraati hai: \4 #\ ka matlab hai chaar hindse. Aap yeh bhi keh sakte hain \>0 #\ (ek ya zyada), \≥0 #\ (sifar ya zyada), \≤1 #\ (zaroori nahin), ya koi hadd jaise \2–4 #\ na ho.

Pattern ki har jagah talaash karne ke liye \⌕\ istemaal karein, jo aap ko @Structure nataij ki ek list deta hai. Kisi hisse ko pakadne ke liye us ka naam \naam2:( … )\ ke sath likhein:

\
'paida hua 2026-06-15' ⌕ ⣿y:(4 #) "-" m:(2 #) "-" d:(2 #)⣿
\

 Har nateeja aap ko milta hua \text\ batata hai, jahan woh \start\ hota hai aur \end\ hota hai, aur pakda hua \groups\ bhi batata hai — yahan \y\, \m\, aur \d\. Kyunke patterns grapheme ke hisaab se milte hain, yeh har zubaan aur har rasm-ul-khat mein ek jaise kaam karte hain.

title: Woh dikhayein jo music baja raha hai
body:
Jo music aap sunte hain woh sirf aadha hissa hai. Yeh @Beat dhaara har beat par player ki poori haalat aap ko deti hai, taake aap jo bhi ho raha ho use bana sakein.

@Beat ke paas hamesha aap ko dene ke liye ek @Downbeat hota hai, is liye aap use foran parh sakte hain. Music shuru hone se pehle yeh beat zero par hota hai aur kuch nahin baj raha hota:

\
dhadkan2: Thaap()
ginti2: dhadkan2.ginti

Stage([
	Jumla('🥁' size: ((ginti2 % 4) = 0) ? 2m 1m)
	Mauseeqi(Dhun([1 1 1 1] saaz: Saaz.dhol))
])
\

 Yeh \count\ har beat par ek se barhta hai, is liye \count % 4\ har chauthi beat par \0\ hota hai. Yeh downbeat hai, aur dhol uchhalta hai.

Yeh poora music ek number mein hai. Lekin ek @Downbeat mein ek \parts\ list bhi hoti hai, har @Part ke liye ek @Track, aur ek @Part jaanta hai ke is ki apni aawaaz abhi kya kar rahi hai: is ki \pitch\, is ki \volume\, is ki \pan\, aur kya woh \sounding\ hai. Inhein banayein to aap ko mix ki bajaye har aawaaz alag alag nazar aati hai:

\
dhadkan2: Thaap()
hisse2•[Hissa]: dhadkan2.hisse.chhaanna(ƒ(p•Hissa) p.bajtaHua)

ƒ unchaai2(p2•Hissa)•# p2.sur[1] ÷ 1semitones

ƒ nuqta2(p3•Hissa)•Jumla
	Jumla(
		'⬤'
		0.4m + (p3.awaaz · 1m)
		jagah: Jagah((p3.pan · 3) · 1m ((unchaai2(p3) · 0.2) - 1) · 1m)
	)

Stage([
	:hisse2.badlo(ƒ(p4•Hissa) nuqta2(p4))
	Mauseeqi([
		Dhun([1 ø 5 ø] saaz: Saaz.piano pan: -1)
		Dhun([ø 8 ø 12] saaz: Saaz.ghanti pan: 1)
	])
])
\

 Har dot wahin hota hai jahan us ka track hota hai: \pan\ use baayein ya daayein rakhta hai, \pitch\ use oopar ya neeche rakhta hai. Kyunke \sounding\ lambe note ke bajte rehne tak sach rehta hai, is liye rukha hua note apna dot rakhta hai aur ghaayab nahin hota.

Chhoti si \height\ function ko dekhein. \pitch\ ek / list hai /, kyunki ek chord ek saath kai surain bajata hai, is liye \p.pitch[1]\ bajti hui surain mein se sab se neechi sur leta hai. Woh number is mein hai: \semitones\, aur is ko \1semitones\ se taqseem karne se woh aam number ban jata hai jise aap neeche diye gaye \0.2\ aur \1m\ ke saath mila sakte hain. Function ko \#\ likh dena akela kaafi nahin: sirf \#\ ka matlab hai / koi bhi / ikai, / koi ikai nahin / , is liye yeh semitone khushi se qabool kar lega aur phir ek line baad un par shikayat karega.

title: Jab kuch ho to aawaaz bajayein
body:
Jawaab sahi ho to ek ding, kuch gire to ek dhamaka — aawaaz ka asar ek chhota sa @Music hai jo sirf ek baar bajta hai aur raasta chhor deta hai.

Do cheezein ise gaane ke bajaye aawaaz ka asar banati hain. \chakkar2: ⊥\  @Track taake uske sur sirf ek baar bajein, hamesha nahin. Aur surron ki fehrist khud us lamhe se aati hai: jab kuch abhi hua ho to is mein sur hote hain, aur baaqi waqt yeh khaali rehti hai.

\
chhuaGaya: ∆ Button()

Stage([
	Jumla('👆 mujhe chhuein' chunaJaSakneWala naam: 'chhuein')
	Mauseeqi(
		Dhun(chhuaGaya ? [1 5 8] [] saaz: Saaz.ghanti chakkar: ⊥)
		dobaara: chhuaGaya
	)
])
\

 Fikar na karein ke agli evaluation par fehrist phir khaali ho jaati hai — jo sur shuru ho chuka ho woh hamesha aakhir tak bajta hai. Jo cheez aap chhor nahin sakte woh hai \replay\. Do baar tap karein to doosra tap bilkul wohi dhun banata hai jo pehla banata hai, is liye kuch nahin badla aur aawaaz dobara nahin aayegi; \replay\ aap yeh kehne ka tareeqa hai / dobara, abhi / na ho.

@Music ko yahan ek * lamhaati * shart chahiye — aisi jo sirf us evaluation par sach ho jisay event ne shuru kiya, jaise upar wala \∆ Button()\ . Koi dairmi cheez, jaise \score > 10\, uske baad hamesha sach rehti hai aur har evaluation par aawaaz dobara shuru kar deti.

Chunke sur sirf ek fehrist hain, aap unhein is se tay kar sakte hain ke * kya * hua, bajaye is ke ke hamesha ek hi cheez bajayein:

\
kunji2: Kunji()
dabayaGaya: ∆ kunji2

Stage([
	Jumla(dabayaGaya ? kunji2 '⌨ koi kunji dabayein' 1m)
	Mauseeqi(
		Dhun(
			dabayaGaya ? [((kunji2 = ' ') ? 1 8)] []
			saaz: Saaz.piano
			chakkar: ⊥
		)
		dobaara: dabayaGaya
	)
])
\

 Dekhein ke \∆ key\ apni alag line mein nikaala jaata hai aur qeemat ki jaanch \key = ' '\ alag se hoti hai. Agar dono ko ek hi shart mein likha jaye to agli be-talluq kunji par aawaaz phir bajti jabke \key\ ab bhi space padha jaata.

title: Music ko action ke saath chalayein
body:
Jo game shuru se aakhir tak ek hi dhun bajaye, woh feeki lagti hai. Agar music ko pata ho ke aap jeet rahe hain ya nahin, to kya hoga?

Koi tareeqa nahin hai ke * rok * ek @Music ko — usay jo rokta hai woh yeh hai ke woh is par na ho: @Stage. Is liye ek haalat rakhein, aur us se milta hua gaana stage par rakhein:

\
marhala: 'menu' … ∆ Button() … (marhala = 'menu') ? 'peecha' 'menu'

mauzoo2: [1 ø 3 ø 5 ø 6 ø]

Stage([
	Jumla((marhala = 'menu') ? '▶ shuru karne ke liye dabayein' '🏃 daudein!' 1m)
	(marhala = 'menu')
		? Mauseeqi(Dhun(mauzoo2 saaz: Saaz.ghanti) raftaar: 72beats/min)
		Mauseeqi(Dhun(mauzoo2 saaz: Saaz.barqiBaaja) raftaar: 132beats/min)
])
\

 Dono gaane wohi aath numbers hain. Sirf saaz aur raftaar badalti hai, aur phir bhi yeh alag dhun lagti hai — kyunki degrees batate hain * scale ka kaun sa qadam *, koi sur nahin, is liye ek @Music unhein dobara samajh sakta hai. Usay yeh dein \paimaana2: Mauseeqi.hamaahangChhota\ aur wohi dhun dara dene wali ban jaati hai, ek bhi sur dobara likhe baghair.

Doosra hissa woh music hai jo halaat ke saath lagataar badalta hai. Badalne se \tempo\ kuch dobara shuru nahin hota — yeh agli dhun par jud jaata hai, is liye dhun tez ho jaati hai aur apni jagah nahin khoti:

\
score: 0 … ∆ Button() … score + 1
jaldi: (score ÷ 10).kamtareen(1)

Stage([
	Jumla('score \score\' 1m)
	Mauseeqi(
		Dhun([1 5 8 5] saaz: Saaz.dhol)
		raftaar: (90 + (jaldi · 90)) · 1beats/min
	)
])
\

 Kaafi baar dabayein to dhol shuru ke muqable mein doguni taaqat se bajte hain. Chhota aur tez sur is baat ko sunai deta hai — lambe ruke hue suron mein raftaar ka badalna mehsoos karna mushkil hota hai.

title: Apne dekhne walon ko saaz chunne dein
body:
Iske baare mein sab kuch @Music ke bajne ke dauran tay kiya ja sakta hai, yahan tak ke yeh bhi ke use kaun bajaye. Dosre @Track ko ek alag @Instrument dein aur dhun apni jagah qaayam rehti hai — sirf aawaaz badalti hai.

@Choice us muntakhab hone wale output ki \name\ wapas deta hai jo dekhne walon ne chuna, is liye ek shart hi kaafi hai ke use saaz bana diya jaye:

\
chunaGaya: Intikhaab()

Stage([
	Group(Qataar() [
		Jumla('🎹' chunaJaSakneWala naam: 'piano')
		Jumla('🎻' chunaJaSakneWala naam: 'violin')
	])
	Mauseeqi(
		Dhun(
			[1 3 5 6 5 3]
			saaz: (chunaGaya = 'violin') ? Saaz.violin Saaz.piano
		)
	)
])
\

 Yeh do muntakhab hone wale phrase hi is ko kaam karne ke qaabil banate hain — @Choice ke paas parhne ko kuch nahin hota jab tak stage par koi cheez \chunneKeQabil: ⊤\ na ho.

Do saaz ek shart mein aa jaate hain. Poori palette nahin aati, aur aap list do baar likhne par majboor ho jaate hain: ek baar buttons ke liye aur ek baar aawaaz ke liye. Is ke bajaye unhein apni banai hui ek structure mein ek saath rakhein, aur dono usi se banayein:

\
•aawaaz2(nishaan2•'' aawaaz3•Saaz)

aawaazein•[aawaaz2]: [
	aawaaz2('🎹' Saaz.piano)
	aawaaz2('🎺' Saaz.bigul)
	aawaaz2('🔔' Saaz.ghanti)
]

chunaGaya: Intikhaab()
milGaya: aawaazein.dhoondo(ƒ(aawaaz4•aawaaz2) aawaaz4.nishaan2 = chunaGaya)
maujooda•aawaaz2: milGaya•ø ? aawaazein[1] milGaya

Stage([
	Group(Qataar() [
		:aawaazein.badlo(
			ƒ(aawaaz5•aawaaz2) Jumla(aawaaz5.nishaan2 chunaJaSakneWala naam: aawaaz5.nishaan2)
		)
	])
	Mauseeqi(Dhun([1 3 5 6 5 3] saaz: maujooda.aawaaz3))
])
\

 Chauthi aawaaz shamil karna ab sirf ek line hai, aur button khud ba khud nazar aa jaata hai. Is \found•ø ?\ nigehbaan par ghaur karein: @List/find jab kuch bhi mel na khaye to \ø\ wapas deta hai, aur aisa tab hota hai jab tak kisi ne kuch chuna na ho — aur badal poora \Bolna\ hona chahiye, kyunki \current\ yehi wada karta hai.

title: Sirf sur nahin, taal bhi likhein
body:
Sirf adaad ki fehrist har sur ko ek jitni lambaai deti hai, jo chaabi wale khilone jaisi lagti hai. Asal taal do jagah se aati hai: woh jaal jo @Track ginta hai, aur woh sur ki qeematein jo aap alag alag adaad par likhte hain.

@Track/beat jaal tay karta hai. Har saada rukn utni hi dair tak rehta hai, aur har \ø\ bhi, isi liye khaamoshi sur ko lamba karne ka sabse aasaan tareeqa hai:

\
Mauseeqi([
	Dhun([1 ø ø ø 5 ø 8 ø] saaz: Saaz.piano)
	Dhun([1 1 1 1 1 1 1 1] saaz: Saaz.dhol taal: 0.5beats)
])
\

 Piano ke pehle sur ke baad teen khaamoshiyan hain, is liye woh chaar dhadkan tak goonjta hai. Drum ka jaal aadhi dhadkan ka hai, is liye uske aath rukn chaar dhadkanein bharte hain jabke piano ke aath rukn aath dhadkanein bharte hain. Yaani piano ek baar chalta hai to drum do baar. Har track apni lambaai par dohrata hai, aur isi tarah ek adad se mukhtalif taal ka mel banta hai.

Khaamoshiyan ginna thaka deta hai, is liye aap lambaai seedhe adad par likh sakte hain. Saada adad ab bhi ek jaal ka qadam hai, aur jis adad par sur ki qeemat likhi ho woh apni lambaai khud batata hai:

\
Mauseeqi(
	Dhun(
		[5 5 5 1𝅘𝅥𝅮𝅭 8𝅘𝅥𝅯 5 1𝅘𝅥𝅮𝅭 8𝅘𝅥𝅯 5𝅗𝅥]
		saaz: Saaz.bigul
		taal: 1𝅘𝅥
	)
)
\

 Yeh chaar chaar dhadkanon ke do hisse hain. \𝅝\ poora sur hai, \𝅗𝅥\ aadha, \𝅘𝅥\ chauthaai, \𝅘𝅥𝅮\ aathwaan hissa aur \𝅘𝅥𝅯\ solhwaan hissa hai, aur nuqta \𝅭\ kisi bhi ko aadha mazeed lamba kar deta hai. Is liye \𝅘𝅥𝅮𝅭\ nuqte wala aathwaan hissa hai jo is march ko aage dhakelta hai. Adad likhne ke baad editor ke neeche alaamaton ki qatar yeh sab dikhati hai.

Ek kaam yeh nahin kar sakte: khaamoshi. \ø\ adad nahin hai, is liye ismein qeemat ki jagah nahin. Iski jagah khaamoshiyan do baar likhein, ya @Note istemaal karein, jo aisi lambaaiyan bhi deta hai jo koi sur ki qeemat likh nahin sakti. \Sur(1 2beats ÷ 3)\ tigna hai, yaani do sur ki jagah mein teen sur.

title: Hisson ko tah dar tah laga kar ek tarteeb banayein
body:
Ek @Track ek dhun hoti hai. Kai dhunein ek saath bajein to band ban jaata hai. Band likhne ki tarkeeb yeh hai ke har hissa alag mausiqi hona zaroori nahin.

Daraje scale ke qadam hote hain, tay shuda sur nahin. Is liye poori bass line wohi dhun ke apne number ho sakti hai jo ek octave neeche kar diye gaye hon. @Track/key ek track ko kuch semitone se aage peechhe karta hai, aur barah semitone theek ek octave hote hain:

\
dhun2: [1 5 8 5 6 3 1 ø]

Mauseeqi([
	Dhun(dhun2 saaz: Saaz.baansuri)
	Dhun(dhun2 saaz: Saaz.barqiBhaariSur kunji: -12semitones awaaz: 60%)
])
\

 Do aawaazein, ek list. Dhun badlein to bass bhi saath badal jaati hai, kyunke badalne ke liye sirf ek hi dhun hai.

Ab aas paas ki jagah bharein. Chords ko dhun ki nahin, apni taal chahiye hoti hai. Track ki apni @Track/beat use woh taal deti hai; \pan\ aawaazon ko daayein baayein phailata hai taake kaan unhein alag alag pehchaan sake:

\
dhun2: [1 5 8 5 6 3 1 ø]

Mauseeqi([
	Dhun(dhun2 saaz: Saaz.baansuri pan: 0)
	Dhun(dhun2 saaz: Saaz.barqiBhaariSur kunji: -12semitones awaaz: 60%)
	Dhun([{1 3 5} ø {1 4 6} ø] saaz: Saaz.barqiNarmSur taal: 2beats awaaz: 35%)
	Dhun([1 ø 2 ø 1 ø 2 3] saaz: Saaz.dhol taal: 0.5beats awaaz: 45%)
])
\

 Awaaz ki buland-pasti dekhein: sirf flute poori awaaz par hai. Poori awaaz par chalne wale hisse band ko zyada buland nahin karte, balki ghaddmadd kar dete hain, kyunke ek saath bajne wali har cheez ko ek hi speaker se guzarna padta hai. Dhun ko \100%\ par shuru karein aur baaki sab kuch uske neeche rakhein.

Pad ki chaar entries \dhadkan2: 2beats\ par aath beat bharti hain, aur drums ki aath entries \0.5beats\ par chaar beat bharti hain. Is liye drums har pad chakkar mein do baar aate hain aur sab kuch ooper phir mil jaata hai. Jab hisse ek doosre se nikal jaate hain to aksar wajah yeh hoti hai ke un ki lambaiyan ek doosre mein barabar taqseem nahin hoti.

title: Aawaaz se alfaaz gawaein
body:
Palette ke har @Instrument mein se, \Saaz.aawaaz\ akela hai jo kuch keh sakta hai. Isko apne @Track sakein ek @Track/words dein aur yeh unhein gaata hai, har note par ek hissa:

\
Mauseeqi(
	Dhun([1 2 3 5 3 1] alfaaz: 'la la la la la la' saaz: Saaz.aawaaz)
	raftaar: 120beats/min
)
\

 Chhe hisse, chhe note. Yahan khaali jagah hi poori qawaid hai: yeh batati hai ke ek hissa kahan khatam hota hai aur agla kahan shuru hota hai. Khamoshi ke liye koi hissa nahin lagta, is liye alfaaz un notes par aate hain jo aap waqai sunte hain. Agar notes se kam hisse likhein to woh dobara shuru se shuru ho jaate hain. Agar kuch bhi na likhein to aawaaz ek / uh / ki aawaaz rokti hai, is liye yeh hamesha kuch na kuch gaati hai.

Yeh hijje angrezi ke nahin hain. Yeh < International Phonetic Alphabet @https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Phonetic_Alphabet> hai, jahan har harf theek ek aawaaz hai aur har aawaaz ka theek ek harf hai. Angrezi hijje yeh nahin kar sakte: \o\ in / go /, / do / aur / women / mein teen alag alag aawaazein hain. Is liye angrezi hijje parhne wali aawaaz ko andaza lagana parta aur woh ghalat andaza lagati. Iska yeh bhi matlab hai ke gaana kisi bhi zubaan mein likhein, ek jaisa chalta hai, kyunke harf aap ke munh ki aawaaz batate hain, aap ki alif-be nahin.

In mein se zyada tar ke liye aap ke keyboard par koi kunji nahin hai, is liye editor ke neeche 🤖 dabayein. Yeh woh har aawaaz dikhata hai jo aawaaz bana sakti hai, saath mein ek lafz jis mein woh aawaaz hai aur ek button jo use bajata hai. Harf ko khud dabane se woh aap ke code mein likha jaata hai. Aawaaz sun kar hi aap use sahi se jaan sakte hain, aur yeh panel hi rehnuma hai. Jo aage hai woh shuru karne ke liye kaafi hai.

Pehle swar (vowels) se shuru karein. Yeh barah zyada tar zaroorat poori karte hain, har ek ek angrezi lafz ke andar dikhaya gaya hai jis mein woh hai:

\a\ f / a / ther, \e\ b / e / d, \i\ s / ee /, \o\ g / o /, \u\ b / oo / t, \ɛ\ h / ea / d, \ɪ\ b / i / t, \ɔ\ b / ou / ght, \ʊ\ b / oo / k, \æ\ c / a / t, \ʌ\ c / u / p, \ə\ / a / bout

Ek akela vowel bhi ek bilkul theek syllable hai, aur unhein ek qatar mein gaana woh sab se saaf tareeqa hai jis se aap ek ki doosre se pehchaan sun sakte hain:

\
Mauseeqi(
	Dhun([1 2 3 4 5] alfaaz: 'a e i o u' saaz: Saaz.aawaaz)
	raftaar: 90beats/min
)
\

 Consonants zyada tar waise hi dikhte hain jaisa aap sochte hain: \p b t d k m n s f l r w\ sab ki aawaaz taqreeban waisi hi hai jaisi angrezi mein hoti hai. Seekhne ke qabil woh aawaazein hain jinhein angrezi do harf se likhti hai, aur ek harf jo apni jagah badal chuka hai. \ʃ\ har chauthi beat par / sh /, \ʒ\ woh hai jo / s / in / measure /, \θ\ woh hai jo / th / in / thin /, \ð\ woh hai jo / th / in / this /, \ŋ\ woh hai jo / ng / in / sing /, aur \j\ woh hai jo / y / in / yes /. Inhein kisi vowel ke aage rakhein to ek lafz ban jaata hai:

\
Mauseeqi(
	Dhun([5 5 3 3 1] alfaaz: 'ʃi si mi lo ʌp' saaz: Saaz.aawaaz)
	raftaar: 100beats/min
)
\

 Ek syllable kai sur par bhi phail sakta hai. Usay hyphen par khatam karein to woh har hyphen ke liye ek aur sur tak chalta hai. Ek hi syllable par surun ki yeh qataar hamdon aur lori ko unki shakal deti hai:

\
Mauseeqi(
	Dhun([1 2 3 2 1] alfaaz: 'glo--- ri' saaz: Saaz.aawaaz)
	raftaar: 140beats/min
)
\

 Teenon hyphen \glo\ ko chaar surun tak le jaate hain, phir \ri\ aakhri sur par aata hai. Jo kuchh aawaaz pehchaan nahin paati, usay woh inkaar karne ke bajaye chhor deti hai, is liye aap bina dhun bigaare tajurba kar sakte hain.

Alfaaz ko waise dikhane ke liye jaise woh gaaye jaate hain, unhein wapas parhein @Beat. @Downbeat/words mein woh hota hai jo us lamhe mein gaaya ja raha ho, is liye ek jumla poora karaoke display ban jaata hai:

\
dhadkan2: Thaap()
Stage([
	Jumla(((dhadkan2.alfaaz.lambaai() = 0) ? '' dhadkan2.alfaaz[1]) 3m)
	Mauseeqi(
		Dhun([1 2 3 5 3 1] alfaaz: 'ðɪs ɪz ə soŋ tə si' saaz: Saaz.aawaaz)
		raftaar: 100beats/min
	)
])
\

@Downbeat/parts mein wahi syllable track ke hisaab se hote hain, agar aap do gaanay walon ko saath ke bajaye alag alag dikhana chahte hain.

title: Mansooba ko maakhaz files mein taqseem karein
body:
Ek mansooba mein ek se zyada @Source ho sakte hain. Data ki lambi list ko alag file mein rakhna
aapke main program ko chhota rakhta hai, taake woh ek nazar mein parha ja sake.

Farz karein aap ko chunne ke liye rangon ki list chahiye. Ek doosra @Source banayein, us ka naam 
/ colors / rakhein, aur list wahan likh dein. Naam se pehle \↑\ ka matlab hai / isay baant dein
mansooba ke baaqi hisson ke saath /:

\
↑ colors/en: ['🔴' '🟠' '🟡' '🟢' '🔵' '🟣']
\

 Yeh / en / naam ke baad batata hai ke naam kis zubaan mein likha hai, taake
doosri zubaan mein aap ka mansooba parhne wala jaan sake ke woh isay parh sakta hai ya nahin.

Ab apne main @Source mein wapas jaayein aur list ko @Borrow se andar layein. Likhein 
\↓\ aur phir doosre maakhaz ka naam:

\
↓ colors

Phrase(colors.random())
\🪲

 Is @Source, / colors / ke andar ab yeh us list ko batata hai jo aap ne baanti thi. Jis cheez par bhi aap
lagayein, \↑\ usay is tarah udhaar liya ja sakta hai: list, number, function, ya structure.

Naya @Source banane ke liye, / maakhaz shamil karein / button mansooba ke neeche hai.
